review_lenses.authority: No ordinary execution grants or inferred root permissions; persistence and resume facts remain separate; release needs explicit adoption.
review_lenses.identity: Root constraint, allowed implementation choice, host selection, executed target and observed target are distinct; no cwd/model selector privilege; complete release identity tuple.
review_lenses.state_effect_readback: Delivery, action event, current state outcome, proof, Stop and Goal are distinct; trusted producer/readback and per-predicate evidence required.
review_lenses.canonicalization: Freeze UTF-8 half-open spans, Unicode/number/order/hash domain and old digest immutability; Python/TS parity must compare independent expected projection.
review_lenses.platform_feasibility: Inventory actual host call/result and persistence surfaces; mark unavailable predicates, preserve ordinary positive path and disclose opaque release channels.
review_lenses.migration_versioning: Version semantic state; legacy generic/text wait never upgrades to trusted fact; preserve original journal and certificate provenance; transactional replay and rollback boundary.
review_lenses.verification_release_boundary: Pure core, raw-language entry, production Stop/Goal, persisted replay, synthetic host and real-model/native/artifact/publication are separate evidence tiers.
